source_evidence: Day328 exact player 'Ok good plan. Now we just wait' approves the immediately preceding companion plan for the 11:00 introduction, including routine notice to Desen, and authorizes waiting until the planned appointment and ordinary attendance. Cirren independently handles the safety notification during the morning: he personally delivers the meeting time and existing counting-shop location to Desen's Watch annex and reunites with the group before departure; the Watch receives the notice, no new warrant, deployment, protection guarantee, instruction or investigative result. No fee, extra meal charge, qualifying additional rest, spell or resource use during the intervening ordinary morning. No further correspondence received before departure; Tavosk's paid notice and royal decision remain pending, not rerolled. D328~11:00 V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar arrive together at the previously known counting shop 200ft uphill of storehouse1. Broker receives the invited party and leads them to the existing rented upper office. Newly established actual Harthvale availability follows the delivered invitation and his commercial interest; Demeric Harthvale, existing syndicate-chair role identified D327, is present and voluntarily receives them. He is a broad, middle-aged former freight factor, weathered hands, neat dark wool coat, warm but deliberate voice; ordinary first-play appearance, no new powers, titles or backstory. Broker remains present. Harthvale has heard of V's river property interests and Sallow recommendation from actual introduction arrangements, not automatically the Watch inquiry, prior covert office search, evidence or V's motives. Broker has previously seen V in worker apron/cap; does not raise the prior encounter at this opening; no assertion of permanent ignorance or recognition. Harthvale says 'Sallow tells me you have an interest in the river's trade. I'd rather hear it from you. What sort of partnership did you have in mind?' No confession, new secret cargo, proposal, transaction, threat, check, feature use or additional V speech. V chooses reply; Mara available for meaningful Help, Cirren attentive, Fenar alert. Fixed roles and finite resources from prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516 preserved. No new security deployment, binding agreement or guarantee of any concession.
